event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearing No. 30 was heard together with hearings No. 26, 27 and 28 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since all hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GEO 222560 was represented by Anastasia Tatarishvili.
UKR 217790 was represented by Varvara Postrelko.
AZE 210840 was represented by Nazrin Mammadova.
The race committee was represented by Ewa Jodlowska (Course Race Officer Area B).
Devi Kituashvilli, support person form GEO, attended the hearing as an interpreter for GEO 222560.
Burgu Algon Giorgianni, Team Leader of the Solidarity Team, and Monica Azun, coach of the Solidarity Team, attended the hearing as observers.
facts: On the 22 June there was no flag T displayed neither ashore, nor on the race committee signal vessel in race area B at any time.
UKR 217798 and AZE 210840 were sailing in the red fleet. When they left the marina, the coach from UKR towed the boats to race area B.
MLT 162847 was sailing in the red fleet. The coach from UKR approached her and gave her a towing line. MLT 162847 accepted the towing line and was towed to race area B.
GEO 222560 was sailing in the yellow fleet. She was towed by a support person from GEO to race area B.
NoR 7.9 states: "Boats shall not be towed except when the race committee displays flag T, either on shore or on the committee vessel."
The race committee applied a Standard Penalty of 5 points in race 5 as stated in Notice No. 7.
conclusions: By applying a Standard Penalty of 5 points to the race sailed nearest in time of the breach, the race committee complied with NoR 7.9.
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
